title: Allosteric communication induced by GTP binding sets off a closed-to-open transition in a bacterial dynamin-like protein
one_liner_zh: 该文用MD模拟研究细菌dynamin样蛋白GTP结合诱导的变构构象变化，虽涉及蛋白-脂膜互作与构象转变，但非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无TF-DNA结合建模，仅方法上对构象动态模拟有间接参考价值。
abstract: Dynamin superfamily proteins are mechanochemical GTPases that operate in highly oligomeric and highly cooperative superstructures to deform lipid membranes. It is known from the structures of a bacterial dynamin-like protein (BDLP) that binding of GTP and association of BDLP with lipids causes a transition from closed to open hinge 1 that affects oligomerization. We trace this radical, large-scale conformational change at the atomic level with unbiased, replica exchange, and umbrella sampling molecular dynamics simulations. We decipher how GTP loading from the GTPase domain to the distal stalk end is mediated by an allosteric network of salt bridges that act in response to GTP binding and subsequent conformational changes in GTPase domain motifs. Two previously undiscovered motifs have been identified whose movements free the paddle from the GTPase domain, allowing large-scale domain rearrangements. In addition, a novel wide-open state of BDLP reminiscent of human dynamin 1 is discovered. Our results explain several aspects of the BDLP cycle and have broad implications for other members of the dynamin family.
abstract_zh: 发动蛋白超家族蛋白是机械化学GTP酶，它们以高度寡聚且高度协同的超结构运作，以变形脂质膜。从细菌发动蛋白样蛋白（BDLP）的结构已知，GTP的结合以及BDLP与脂质的关联导致铰链1从闭合状态向开放状态转变，这影响寡聚化。我们通过无偏、副本交换和伞形采样分子动力学模拟，在原子层面追踪这一剧烈的、大规模构象变化。我们解析了GTP如何从GTP酶结构域传递至远端柄端，这一过程由响应GTP结合及随后GTP酶结构域基序构象变化的盐桥变构网络介导。我们识别出两个先前未发现的基序，其运动使桨叶从GTP酶结构域释放，从而允许大规模结构域重排。此外，发现了一种类似于人发动蛋白1的BDLP新型宽开放状态。我们的结果解释了BDLP循环的多个方面，并对发动蛋白家族的其他成员具有广泛意义。
